answer: Start with the cost ledger: every new identity locks a bond rising 20 copper per prior identity from the same funder — 200 for the first, 2,180 for the hundredth — then must finish a chain of 12 verified jobs for 12 different counterparties, each receipt chained to the last. One fake costs 200 copper plus 12 real jobs; 100 fakes cost 119,000 copper and 1,200 jobs, and receipts from one counterparty cluster count for zero. A raven audit samples chains at random; one forged receipt burns the bond and freezes the chain. The spiral is deliberate: each extra identity costs more.
